verdicts.explanation: The homepage carries no JSON-LD at all, so there is no Organization/sameAs block to anchor the brand entity.
The phone number and chat/email options on the contact page are plain text, not tel:/mailto: links or a form, matching the finding's own link/form counts of zero.

claims.title: Open positions on /karriere are loaded through a job-search iframe widget
claims.why: A non-rendering fetcher reads the iframe tag pointing at jobs.bosch.de, not the job listings inside it, so no current openings appear in the page's own HTML for an assistant to quote.

suggested_action.summary: Render at least a handful of current job titles as static HTML links on /karriere, alongside the search widget.
how: List several current openings as plain HTML links (title, location) above or beside the widget.
Keep the interactive widget for filtering and full search.
suggested_action.verify: curl -s https://www.bosch.de/karriere/ shows job titles in the HTML body, not only the iframe tag.

site_specific: Add an Organization JSON-LD block to the homepage naming 'Robert Bosch GmbH'.
Include a sameAs array linking the company's Wikidata/Wikipedia entry and official social profiles.
Repeat the same block, or a link to it, on the Impressum and Kontakt pages so the entity is consistent site-wide.
Turn the referenced email contact into a mailto: link.
Add a direct link to the live chat or a contact form at the point where 'Chat' is mentioned.
